proposedAction: Exclude only these exact 60 standing domains as outside playable space. Preserve all raw collision bodies and every other standing domain.
reason: The high caps of invisible boundary volumes, bell-tower ledges and Tree-room upper trim appear outside gameplay in the extracted scene. Physical contact alone does not establish their gameplay eligibility.

approval.question: Can you confirm that the red patches are outside playable space, especially the Tree-room upper rim?
approval.scope: All 60 red standing domains in the linked Ascent viewer.

decisions.reason: Dara confirmed this exact red patch is outside playable space.
